purpose: Close Relay gate criterion 6 at the policy/design level without enabling payment or promising external delivery.

customer_payment_gate.rule: If approval cannot be machine-verified at checkout time, do not create or expose a payable checkout path.

limited_pilot_scope.product: Outcome Economics Intelligence structured-search outcome comparison
limited_pilot_scope.claims_rule: Only claims directly supported by recorded real paid benchmark evidence may appear in customer-facing copy.
limited_pilot_scope.request_equivalence_rule: Customer task must map to the benchmarked task class using the locked request-equivalence controls; otherwise reject before payment.
limited_pilot_scope.acceptance_rule: Acceptance criteria must be deterministic and recorded with the request before payment.

workflow: validate task equivalence and deterministic acceptance criteria before checkout
after successful payment, execute only the approved task class
mark DELIVERED only if every required acceptance check passes

failure_handling.prepayment_failure: Reject request and collect no payment.
failure_handling.postpayment_failure: Do not substitute a weaker deliverable. Mark FAILED_REFUND_REQUIRED and initiate full refund through the original payment rail.
failure_handling.indeterminate_failure: Treat as failure; do not claim delivery or retry in a way that risks duplicate charge without idempotency proof.
failure_handling.evidence_failure: If required evidence record is missing or acceptance cannot be proven, treat as FAILED_REFUND_REQUIRED.

refund_policy.amount: 100% of customer charge for failed/non-accepted pilot delivery
automatic_trigger_conditions: deliverable misses any deterministic acceptance criterion
approved task class cannot be completed
required evidence record cannot be produced
security/payment control enters indeterminate or failed state after charge
refund_policy.no_refund_condition: A deliverable that passes the pre-recorded deterministic acceptance criteria is not automatically refundable under this failure policy; statutory/customer rights remain unaffected.
refund_policy.truthfulness: Never record REFUNDED until the payment provider confirms refund submission/completion as appropriate.

minimum_customer_surface: plain-language failure/refund statement visible before checkout
method to report missing/incorrect delivery or duplicate charge
support.handling_rule: Support cases must be linked to request_id, payment reference without exposing secrets, delivery evidence and resolution state.
support.claims_rule: Do not advertise response-time SLAs until they have been operationally validated.

dry_run_requirement: Before APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT, execute an end-to-end zero-charge dry run exercising success and post-payment-failure simulation through the same state machine, with no external customer and no fabricated payment event.
relay_rule: This file defines handling; it does not itself make criterion 6 PASS. Independent Relay/QA must verify the implemented state machine, customer surfaces and dry-run evidence before approval.
